metadata.title: Madhya Pradesh Krishi Vibhag district-wise crop APY, 2019-20
metadata.source: Madhya Pradesh Department of Agriculture (Krishi Vibhag), annual compendium PDF
metadata.extraction_method: pdfplumber table extraction; crop-column identity determined by cross-validating each column-block's (area, production) against dashboard/data/crop_stats_des/ -- see this script's own docstring for why (the PDF's own column headers are in a legacy non-Unicode font, Kruti Dev 010, that cannot be extracted directly)
